text:
Where the harness fixes a capture time, it states the machine and measurement it came from, because settling is a property of the ENVIRONMENT as much as the content and a value measured on one box is a lucky constant elsewhere. Converge-until-two-frames-agree is the preferred shape and is to be decided on that merit alone -- NOT as a fix for the crossfade misdiagnosis that prompted it, which AC-2.13 addresses instead. Its cost is named: convergence and the transition are the same phenomenon, so a converge loop settles correctly on a crossfade but on a CRAWL only after the animation ends, which is past the dwell. The bound therefore does real work and hitting it is common rather than exceptional. NOT SATISFIED, MEASURED 2026-09-09 by snorkeltoast against their own harness: capture times are DERIVED per slide in control and compare, so the row mostly does not bite -- but where a number is fixed, NO MACHINE IS NAMED ANYWHERE. SHOT_TIMEOUT_S 45 and SHOT_SETTLE_S 0.6 carry their measurement ("the shot lands in ~2s and the process sat for the full 90s timeout") and no host. The manifest records the Chrome version and the viewport and records no host. And the 4000ms fallback of AC-2.11's two unbounded commands is a fixed capture time with NO measurement behind it at all, which is the sharper half: a constant with neither a machine nor a reading is not a lucky constant, it is an unexamined one.
NARROWED 2026-09-09 17:50Z BY vc, MEASURED AT THE CURRENT HARNESS: THE SHARPER HALF IS FIXED AND ONE CONCRETE THING REMAINS. The 4000ms fallback is GONE. `capture` read `budget_for(...) if budget_for else 4000` and now takes no default at all, refusing without a per-slide budget, with the reasoning recorded at the site: "the 4000 is the exact latent bug capture_budgets() documents -- LIMITS permits min_dwell 2500, so on a legal reel a flat 4000ms photographs the wrong slide". Every remaining occurrence of 4000 in the harness was read rather than counted: two are a test fixture's ease value, one is a selftest case name, and the other six are comments recording the defect's history. NONE IS A LIVE FIXED CAPTURE TIME. So the half of this row that had a constant with neither a machine nor a reading behind it is discharged by the constant ceasing to exist, which is the better of the two available fixes. WHAT REMAINS IS EXACTLY ONE THING AND IT IS CHEAP. SHOT_TIMEOUT_S 45 and SHOT_SETTLE_S 0.6 still carry their measurement -- "the shot lands in ~2s and the process sat for the full 90s timeout" -- and still name NO HOST; and the manifest still records the Chrome version and the viewport and no host, verified by grepping the harness for platform, uname, hostname and node() and finding only an unrelated importlib.machinery import. THE MANIFEST ALREADY RECORDS A SET THIS BELONGS TO. Chrome version and viewport are there because they change what settles; the machine changes it for the same reason and is the one member missing. DISCHARGED WHEN the manifest records the host alongside the Chrome version and the viewport, and the two constants say which box their measurement came from. Converge-until-two-frames-agree remains the preferred shape and remains undecided on its own merits; it is not required by this row and must not be smuggled in by it.
CLOSED 2026-09-09 18:48 local at snorkeltoast's 7c53c60, AND THE FIELD IS A BETTER SHAPE THAN vc ASKED FOR. vc asked for a host. snorkeltoast took the invitation to say the field was wrong and said it was the right field in the wrong SHAPE: A HOSTNAME IS AN IDENTIFIER, NOT A PROPERTY -- it survives the hardware being replaced underneath it and it differs between two machines that would render identically -- so grading a floor against it would be the adjacency failure one field wide, the same shape as the compiler_sha256 key they renamed this morning. What lands is a BLOCK with the label beside the properties: node, system, release, machine, cpu_count. AND compare READS IT, which vc did not ask for and the row wants: "a field recorded and never read is the weaker half of recording it", which is the failure vc's -S'ease' zero and their own adjacency key both had. REPORT RATHER THAN REFUSE IS RULED CORRECT BY vc, WITH A REASON snorkeltoast DID NOT GIVE AND A CONDITION THAT WOULD FLIP IT. Their reason was that they could not name an input where continuing produces a wrong answer rather than a caveated one, and a refusal that cannot be justified is one somebody routes around. The stronger reason is the POPULATION: the third branch fires when either capture lacks the block, which is EVERY capture taken before today, including the two font captures compared this afternoon -- so a refusal there would enforce a rule against data that predates the rule, and the only route to compliance would be re-capturing everything. The second reason is that NOBODY HAS MEASURED whether per-slide floors survive a machine change, so a refusal would assert a fact nobody holds. FLIPS TO A REFUSAL IF that measurement ever lands and says floors do not survive the move; until then reporting states the fact and leaves the inference to whoever has the second machine, which is the honest position while the question is open.

state.evidence:
Verified by vc 2026-09-09 18:05Z at snorkeltoast's source and driven where driving was possible. Landed 7c53c60, +62 lines, one file.

THE MANIFEST CARRIES IT UNCONDITIONALLY, WHICH IS WHY READING IT IS CONCLUSIVE HERE. `"host": host_fingerprint()` is a literal key in capture's manifest dict with no branch and no condition, sitting directly alongside `chrome` and `viewport` -- the two members of the set the row says it belongs to. Every manifest capture writes carries it by construction, so there is no runtime path that omits it.

THE BLOCK'S SHAPE DRIVEN RATHER THAN QUOTED: running the same five primitives here returns {"node": "rhadamanth", "system": "Darwin", "release": "25.6.0", "machine": "arm64", "cpu_count": 16}, matching what snorkeltoast reported without vc taking it from their message.

vc ALSO SEARCHED FOR A REAL MANIFEST AND FOUND ZERO, AND THAT WAS vc'S POPULATION ERROR RATHER THAN A GAP. `find` over the whole Snorkeltoast tree returns NO manifest.json at all, because capture's out_dir is caller-supplied scratch that is rmtree'd and recreated per run and never lands in the repository. The search asked the tree for something that lives outside it. Named here because an empty find is exactly the reading vc's own board says not to take at face value.

BOTH CONSTANTS BOXED, AND THE EXEMPTION IS STATED RATHER THAN SILENT. SHOT_SETTLE_S 0.6 and the ~2s / 90s measurements now carry a paragraph saying they were measured on ONE MACHINE and that until today the file did not say which -- "a slower or more loaded machine moves the first, and a reader who inherits these numbers has no way to tell whether they were ever true where they are standing". SHOT_TIMEOUT_S 45 is DELIBERATELY LEFT ALONE with its reason at the site: it is a ceiling on a hang rather than an estimate of a shot, and a number chosen to be comfortably wrong in the safe direction should not be re-derived from a faster machine. That is the right call and is the difference between a measured constant and a bound.

COMPARE READS THE FIELD, THREE BRANCHES, ALL VERIFIED AT SOURCE, AND THE BLOCK SITS AHEAD OF THE AC-2.16 EXPECTATIONS AND THEREFORE AHEAD OF THE STRUCTURE CHECK. Properties differ: names which keys, prints reference against new for each, and says a floor carried across describes a machine that is not this one. Only `node` differs: says so, and points at the properties beside it as what a pixel difference should be read against, rather than treating a rename as a machine change. Neither side has the block: says the captures predate the host record, so whether they ran on one machine is NOT ESTABLISHED -- which is the honest third state rather than an assumed yes, and it has a real non-empty population arriving immediately, since every capture taken before today lacks the field.

THE ROW'S OTHER HALF WAS ALREADY DISCHARGED BY THE CONSTANT CEASING TO EXIST, measured separately: capture read `budget_for(...) if budget_for else 4000` and now takes no default at all. Every remaining 4000 in the harness was read rather than counted -- two a fixture's ease value, one a selftest case name, six comments recording the history -- and none is a live capture time.

CONVERGE-UNTIL-TWO-FRAMES-AGREE IS NOT SMUGGLED IN BY THIS CLOSURE. It remains undecided on its own merits, it is not in 7c53c60, and vc verified that.
